documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for the financial year 2025-26, driven by the commercial commissioning of its new Alu-Zinc coating line and augmentation of its existing colour-coating line. The company crossed the H1,000 Crore revenue milestone with strong growth in EBITDA and profit after tax, supported by operating leverage and improved product mix. Management outlined future revenue targets of H1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and H3,000 Crore for FY 2028-29, alongside a planned H100 Crore investment in a new cold-rolling mill. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and a 15% increase in sales tonnage compared to the previous year. Management detailed ongoing capacity expansions, including an integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 110,800 TPA and a colour coating manufacturing line expansion from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA, funded entirely through internal accruals.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new integrated Alu-Zinc production line to result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The colour coating manufacturing line investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates reporting a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning of its new capacities.
guidance.quote: The Company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning its new capacities.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes and economic growth are accelerating the adoption of galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested H85 Crore in a new Alu-Zinc Line of 110,800 TPA, which was funded through internal accruals and commissioned in June 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year. This investment of H85 Crore was funded through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line that will enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
capex_expansion.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 due to a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to commission its new colour coating manufacturing line during the latter part of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
